screen.title: SPIKE · 信号中心 · 1.618 全屏壁纸模拟盘 (Apple Glass)

request.prompt: Refactor this actual SPIKE 1.618 paper-monitor production screen, not a design specification poster. User wants candlestick chart as FULL VIEWPORT wallpaper, exactly like the product's Monday 1.618 workspace, with small Apple translucent frosted-glass floating controls; eliminate the large dashboard/card layout. Use current light glass style, clear green #169873 and rose #d7355d candles, subtle ambient white-blue background, thin luminous edges, blur and restrained shadow. Main background is a real interactive candle chart with Monday high/low and upper/lower 1.618 price rays, names AND numbers. Default chart symbol follows the most recently OPENED FUNDED paper trade by fill time (open or closed), within selected track; user can select a previous trade from a compact floating list and return to latest. Show small up-arrow '多头开仓 · 123.45' at a long's fill candle and down-arrow '空头开仓 · 123.45' at a short fill candle, entry line anchored at fill time and target line. No invented initial stop (there is no stop before confirmation); only show entry-price stop after backend says activated. Ended trades can have exit marker. ALL design examples synthetic placeholders, use SOL/USDT placeholder 123.45, not real balances/trades; no account credentials or private data. Compact top-left glass capsule with symbol, selected trade side/status, track selector '60m 主轨 / 5m 研究轨', a discreet '模拟' badge. A minimal floating account strip shows realized equity, realized P&L, closed count/win rate (no R metrics). Top navigation should float unobtrusively, preserve signal-center records/analysis links. A slim collapsible glass records panel (desktop ~320px) with tabs 持仓/已结束/触价, search, funded/shadow scope, selectable trade rows, detail on demand. Default compact overview should let chart dominate. Bottom-center glass dock for period 5m/15m/1H/4H, optional 6 MA OFF by default, show full range/latest candles and follow-latest-trade control. Leave price/time axes accessible and do not cover TradingView attribution. On 390px/320px mobile, use top compact capsule, a tiny account disclosure, bottom dock and expandable records sheet; no horizontal overflow, touch targets >=44px. Animate floating panels with transform/opacity, avoid resizing chart on panel open/close. Produce the screen image and responsive frontend HTML/CSS as implementation reference. This is READ-ONLY simulated trading; no real buy/sell/order buttons, no new strategy rules.
